correctness.rationale: Dissipative K=H-i gamma0|0><0|-i gammau|u><u| decomposes orthogonally into the common trap-orthogonal H-invariant dark space and its bright complement. All eigenvalues of K restricted to bright have strictly negative imaginary parts, otherwise a real eigenvector of H would be orthogonal to both traps and hence dark. Thus asymptotic survival is the dark orthogonal projection and does not depend on strictly positive gamma magnitudes. Walsh eigenspaces have trap Gram matrix 2^-d[[C_k,K_k(r)],[K_k(r),C_k]]. End k=0,d each have rank one; for r=d trap projections are proportional in every k, giving total d+1; for 1<=r<d and interior k both Walsh signs occur, so determinant positive, rank 2 per interior k and total 2d. Inverse Gram gives the exact Krawtchouk site formula. The k=1 Fourier sign vector criterion confines unit absorption in the nonantipodal case to 0,u,all-ones,and all-ones xor u; the antipodal Hamming-shell formula yields only weight 0,d. Independently recomputed exact Gram projections for all 640 local starts with 2<=d<=6 and every r, agreeing with every finite formula, bright dimension and unit-absorption sites. Analytic decomposition rather than small-d verification proves all d>=2.

originality.rationale: Novo et al. (2015) explicitly analyze a SINGLE absorbing site on a hypercube and obtain the known d+1 bright dimension and Hamming-shell efficiency; that already implies the antipodal two-trap formula by observing proportional projected traps. Those cases are NOT independently novel. Razzoli et al. (2021) also give the general single-trap bright-space method. The new residue is the complete two-distinct-trap spectral rank dichotomy, nonantipodal 2d, the all-site Krawtchouk law and exact complete-absorption site classification. The inspected primary sources explicitly assume one trap and do not directly imply the nonantipodal formula without the new two-projection Gram analysis.
residual_risks: The antipodal single-trap equivalent is mathematically covered by Novo et al. and MUST NOT be independently advertised as original.

value.rationale: The location of two traps is a natural transport-design parameter. The all-d sharp antipodal redundancy/nonantipodal rank jump and exact spatial survival law are complete natural invariants, providing controlled benchmarks for coherent loss and symmetry breaking rather than only finite numerical experiments.

final_claim: For uniform continuous-time coherent hopping on Q_d with two distinct positive-rate absorbers, d>=2, the bright (eventually absorbed) subspace has dimension d+1 exactly for antipodal placement and 2d otherwise, giving corresponding uniform-site average absorption. An exact Krawtchouk expression gives every localized survival probability; nonantipodal zero-survival sites are precisely the two traps and their complements, while antipodal zero-survival sites are only the trap pair.
limitations: Uniform nonzero hopping on binary hypercube, exactly two distinct positive continuous absorbers, d>=2.
Only infinite-time unconditioned absorption; no finite-time guarantee, disorder or additional trap claims.
